blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace Press Officer Claire Castro on Wednesday urged the public to collect rainwater from Super Typhoon Rosal (international name: Champi), echoing President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s advice to do so ahead of Super El Niño. During a Palace briefing, Castro assured the public that concerned government agencies were prepared to respond to the super typhoon.
